verdict.rationale: Alloy's own marketing claims 'fully auditable agentic automation' for AML and fraud checks, and its transaction-monitoring workflows generate alerts and investigations. That points to an in-product agentic capability in the alert-investigation space, but nothing shows an agent that investigates a transaction alert or drafts review notes. missing for 10: documentation of an agent investigating individual transaction alerts, agent-generated review notes or case summaries, how analysts interact with the agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
